parsed_profile_json.title: FLARED 7F & 9F PRE-ENHANCED COMPRESSOR R1 BLADE RECOMMENDATIONS
parsed_profile_json.purpose: To purpose of this TIL is to inform affected users of the risk of R1 tip cracks, or tip corner liberations and to provide recommendations to help improve unit availability and reliability.
parsed_profile_json.compliance_category_text: Maintenance - Identifies maintenance guidelines or best practices for reliable equipment operation.
scope_of_work: Inspection and maintenance scope per the listed reference documents in the field.
Compressor rotor unstack and R1 blade replacement at repair shop.
service_recommendation_line_items: Follow the operational and maintenance best practices to avoid or limit the likelihood of heavy tip rubs as described in TIL 1509.
During planned or annual borescope inspections, monitor the R1 blade tips for indications of rubs and evidence of corrosion pitting.

If R1 tip rubs are identified, or if R1 tips had previously rubbed or repaired, or if the rotor has previously operated with or currently operating with uniform spaced S0 and S1 vanes, perform a non-destructive inspection (NDI) of all R1 blades as described in TIL 1509.
If new R1 tip rubs or indications are identified, or if R1 tip indications are repaired, perform repeat R1 tip NDI per the schedule described in TIL 1509.
Consider installing a full set of enhanced R1 blades whenever the unit rotor is sent to a GE repair shop and scope requires unstacking the compressor rotor.
Optionally, consider unstacking the compressor rotor to replace the R1 blades at the next opportunity the unit rotor is sent to a GE repair shop.
Until the full set of R1 blades are replaced, continue with the operation, maintenance, and inspection guidelines per this TIL and TIL 1509.
parsed_profile_json.completion_criteria_text: This TIL can be considered complete when the above recommendations are incorporated into the site's maintenance planning practices, or when the full set of R1 blades are replaced.
parsed_profile_json.maintenance_trigger_text: Applicable to flared 7F and 9F gas turbines operating with pre-enhanced (standard) rotor stage-1 (R1) blades that meet any of the following criteria: prior R1 tip rubs/tip indications/tip corner loss/tip repairs; currently operating with or previously operated with uniform spaced S0 and S1 vanes; visible signs of corrosion pitting in the forward compressor.
recommended_interval_or_trigger: During planned or annual borescope inspections, monitor the R1 blade tips for indications of rubs and evidence of corrosion pitting.
If new R1 tip rubs or indications are identified, or if R1 tip indications are repaired, perform repeat R1 tip NDI per the schedule described in TIL 1509.
parsed_profile_json.usage_counter_requirements_text: It could take several start-stop cycles following the rub event before an indication is identified.
parsed_profile_json.frame_or_model_applicability_text: Applicable to flared 7F and 9F gas turbines operating with pre-enhanced (standard) rotor stage-1 (R1) blades.
parsed_profile_json.hardware_or_part_configuration_text: Pre-enhanced (standard) rotor stage-1 (R1) blades; higher risk noted for units with current or previous operation with uniform spaced S0 and S1 vanes; recommendation to replace with enhanced R1 blades (full airfoil shot-peened).

source_snippets.snippet: To purpose of this TIL is to inform affected users of the risk of R1 tip cracks, or tip corner liberations and to provide recommendations to help improve unit availability and reliability.
During planned or annual borescope inspections, monitor the R1 blade tips for indications of rubs and evidence of corrosion pitting.

If R1 tip rubs are identified, or if R1 tips had previously rubbed or repaired, or if the rotor has previously operated with or currently operating with uniform spaced S0 and S1 vanes, perform a non-destructive inspection (NDI) of all R1 blades as described in TIL 1509.
If new R1 tip rubs or indications are identified, or if R1 tip indications are repaired, perform repeat R1 tip NDI per the schedule described in TIL 1509.
The liberated R1 tip corners resulted in considerable distress to the downstream compressor section.
Owing to the extent of distress, the compressor rotor required replacement. Multiple stator vanes were also replaced as a part of unit rebuild activities.

The investigation concluded that the R1 tip cracking initiated due to the combined effect of degraded material properties at the blade tip from prior rubs and corrosion pitting, and previous operation with uniform spaced S0 and S1 vanes.
This TIL can be considered complete when the above recommendations are incorporated into the site's maintenance planning practices, or when the full set of R1 blades are replaced.
Enhanced R1 blades, in case of part replacement at repair shop.
Borescope tool, and fluorescent penetrant inspection or red dye penetrant inspection consumables for in-situ inspections per TIL 1509.
